outcomes: To notice changes and see opportunities for growth, stay open to new experiences, consider a variety of viewpoints, and handle stress in a positive way.
To improve professional manner by learning guidelines or rules of the work setting, and look for work opportunities that would be a good match for personal strengths and skills.
To have a basic understanding of computer, tablet, and smartphone hardware and software and know what technology tools will help people work together.

To know the difference between empathy and sympathy and connect with others by being a good listener, develop good relationships with people from different backgrounds, and make decisions based on client or customer needs by looking at things from their point of view.

To know how to speak in a professional manner, communicate using technology tools, choose words wisely and use non-verbal communication, and be an attentive listener while asking questions or repeating back to make sure points were understood correctly.
To understand diversity in the workplace, respect people's differences, share leadership by gathering ideas and using skills of all team members, and finding positive ways to deal with conflict.
